title: Multiple Concerns — Grief, Substance Use, Relationship Stress
description: Patient presents with several overlapping concerns requiring organized prioritization

conversation.content: There's a lot going on. My mother passed away six months ago, my marriage is struggling, and I've been drinking more than I should.
I'm sorry about your mother. That sounds like a very difficult few months. Can you tell me a bit more about how you've been coping?
Not well. I cry a lot. I've had trouble eating. I drink most evenings now — sometimes quite a bit — which my wife isn't happy about.
How much would you say you're drinking on those evenings?
Maybe 4-6 drinks. Sometimes more on weekends. I know it's too much.
How has all of this affected your daily functioning — work, sleep, relationships?
I'm working but distracted. Sleep is difficult — I fall asleep but wake up at 3am and can't get back to sleep. My wife and I are arguing more.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or not wanting to be here?
No. I want to get through this. My kids need me.
Have you ever spoken to a professional about any of this before?
Never. I come from a family where you don't talk about these things. But I realized I needed help.
